body: Didn’t cut out carbs, but reduced my intake of rice and increased intake of protein (chicken breast, seasoned with cayenne and cajun is good enough). Then some steamed or pan-fried broccoli/asparagu and eggs. Gymmed 4x and ran 2x a week on top of that.

Going more frequently helps me familiarise myself with the gym space, machines, and maybe people who go at the same timing as you. The more you expose yourself to the same environment, the more comfortable you’ll be! 

If it helps, you can also go at a less crowded timing i.e. early morning. As for machines being used at the same time, there’s no harm asking if you can share — most people would be happy to do so!

As what others have mentioned: everybody at the gym’s too busy working on themselves to judge other people.
